newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-INJURED DRIVER REMAINS IN COMA.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-INJURED DRIVER REMAINS IN COMA.

text.p: British racing driver Soames Langton remained in a coma on Monday with head and neck injuries.
Langton was seriously injured when his Porsche crashed into a concrete wall during an international sportscar race at the Nogaro circuit on Sunday.
He was taken unconscious to hospital with three broken neck vertebrae and severe cranial bruising.

His team manager Paul Lanzante said that Langton was likely to be kept in a controlled coma for several days until his injuries were stabilised. Formula One medical chief Sid Watkins is monitoring the situation.
Exactly 11 years to the day of the accident -- October 6 1985 -- Langton's father Stephen was killed in a historic car race at Brands Hatch, England.
